summary: GG2026 Phase 8: Admin Control System - ALL 32 backend tests PASS. Full SEO monitoring and control infrastructure verified. All 12 admin/seo endpoints working with JWT auth protection.

GET /api/admin/seo/dashboard.details: Returns full dashboard with all 8 sections (settings, page_types, agents, publishing, serp, articles, sitemap, indexing) plus generated_at timestamp

GET /api/admin/seo/settings.details: Returns page_types (6 toggles), agents (5 toggles), publishing (auto_publish, min/max_per_day), serp (auto_sync, provider) settings

POST /api/admin/seo/settings.details: Toggles settings by dot-path (e.g., agents.keyword_intelligence = false). Returns 400 if path missing.

GET /api/admin/seo/page-types.details: Returns toggles with page counts for 6 page types: company_sub_pages, bonus_hub_pages, payment_hub_pages, company_articles, programmatic_pages, guide_pages

GET /api/admin/seo/agents.details: Returns 5 agents (keyword_intelligence, content_generator, internal_linking, update, technical_seo) with enabled toggle, total_jobs, completed, failed, success_rate

GET /api/admin/seo/publishing.details: Returns publish queue overview with settings, total, by_status (pending/scheduled/publishing/published/failed), today (published/scheduled/limit), recent_published

GET /api/admin/seo/companies.details: Returns company priority list with name, base_slug, sort_order, rating, bonus_amount, articles, programmatic_pages, queue_items, coverage_score (max 100)

POST /api/admin/seo/companies/priority.details: Updates company sort_order by base_slug. Returns 400 if base_slug missing.

GET /api/admin/seo/serp.details: Returns SERP provider status: settings, providers (ahrefs/semrush/dataforseo with configured boolean), any_configured, fallback_mode, recent_jobs

GET /api/admin/seo/articles.details: Returns article generation coverage: company_articles (total/published), general_articles, ai_generated_content count, generation_jobs, coverage (firms_with_articles/total_firms/coverage_pct)

GET /api/admin/seo/sitemap.details: Returns sitemap health with 10 sitemaps (name/type/est_urls/status), total_sitemaps, total_urls, health status, warnings list

GET /api/admin/seo/indexing.details: Returns programmatic page indexing stats: programmatic_pages (total/indexable/not_indexable/indexable_pct), company_articles (published/unpublished), non_indexable_reasons, recommendations

Auth protection.details: All 12 /api/admin/seo/* endpoints return 401 without valid JWT token

Existing routes unbroken.details: All Phase 1-7 routes still working correctly

mocked_apis.note: All APIs are real, no mocking used

seed_data_creation: Default admin settings seeded on first access via AdminControlSystem.get_settings()
